name: team-kanban
description: v0.7.0: SM-002, a project's issues are written with the label declared on that project's Jira label(s): line, never one derived from its #project slug; a project with no declared label gets no project label and a flag in the sync report. v0.6.0: Jira (project MOXY) is the single canonical task board. The vault kanban (KANBAN_VIEW.md) and all Slack task flows are retired — no Obsidian source-of-truth, no dual-authority sync-back, no Slack scraping, and no #general digest. Team members file their own tickets directly in Jira (including from Slack via the Jira Slack app). The skill now sweeps only non-chat sources (Google Drive Active Tasks, Google Calendar, Gmail) for genuinely-new action items, files them to MOXY with best-practice issue authoring (Context/Acceptance/Notes descriptions, sub-items as real Subtasks, dependencies as Blocks issue links, new tickets default to Backlog), and maintains board hygiene (priorities, column limits, In Review reviewer pairings, dedup against open + recently-Done issues). Bulk writes to the shared tracker remain human-gated.
